summary: The evaluation suite has ONE path: every corpus case names a real room at a real instant, composes the deployment's own Nora against a sandbox database of its own cloned beside the deployment's nora_eval clone, and is seeded with what that room actually held then, at its own clock. Room hashing, hand-authored knowledge and per-case config are gone.
details: nora/subject/sandbox.py: `sandbox_database(source_url)` clones a fresh migrated database beside the source per case (CREATE DATABASE ... TEMPLATE, the test suite's own mechanism) and drops it on exit; `sandbox_from_snapshot(subject, source_url=, before_ms=)` reads the subject's OWN room from the source through a read-only engine and writes it in with real timestamps, refusing a source that is the subject's own database, a subject whose clock is not frozen at the moment, and a moment with no rows.

nora/subject/obtain.py: `room_for`/`workspace_for` deleted; `Subject.unit`/`.culture_key` are resolved from the room's policy entry (the check that unit == memory.workspace_id is gone — the deployment fails it on every room); `_baseline()` points Honcho at a fixed `<workspace>-eval` sibling and maps `host.docker.internal` to loopback when composing on the host outside a container.

nora/subject/knowledge.py: `deliver()`/`arrive()` take `person` (a roster person_id, resolved to that member's platform id) and `deliver()` takes `mention` (structural @-mention via the registry's self_aliases) — with the deployment's text trigger off, a mention is how the inbound path engages her.

evals/backbone.py: `Spec(source_url, entry, overrides, repeat, judge, identity, policy, template)`; `_drive` has one path (snapshot → sandbox → seed → drive) and ERRORs an UNANCHORED case rather than skipping it; `{trigger}` renders against the composed subject's own trigger text; the note-candidates corpus assertions (`must_cite`/`anchor_date`/`creates`/`updates`) are checked again, having been dropped in the SDK port. evals/rebuilt/runner.py (the old harness) is deleted.

evals/scenarios.py: the loader refuses any case key outside `CASE_KEYS` and any corpus-level `config:`/`policy:`; `snapshot:` states exactly platform/conversation_id/before_ms; `parked:` (reason P-A only) keeps a case out of the active set; `census()` reports total/active/parked/unanchored and `python -m evals` prints it per corpus.

evals/__main__.py: `--source-url` (default derived from the deploy host's .env, database `nora_eval`) replaces `--database-url`; a source whose database name is not `*_eval` is refused, so the suite cannot be pointed at production. scripts/refresh_eval_clone.sh / `make eval-source` rebuild the clone from production by pg_dump.

evals/corpora/*: all 150 cases converted — anchored to real moments in the deployment's rooms, parked P-A where no real room has produced the moment, or left unanchored (the 13 tool-result-seam cases) so they ERROR visibly. Discord-anchored tag cases moved to the Signal room, because Discord's adapter is off in the sandbox and a mention cannot fire there.

design/evaluation/11-the-sandbox-rebuild.md §1.3 records what landed and the decisions taken where the doc was open (trigger corpora engage by mention; reminders/candidates/Honcho remain empty tiers; R1 not yet mechanical).
